notes: Bear Form tank at 60. Primal Bite on its 6 s cooldown, Lacerate kept ticking (Rend and Tear reads it), Maul queued on the next swing, Swipe as the rage dump, Barkskin on cooldown and Frenzied Regeneration as the heal under half health. Measured in the sim's tank fight (level 63 boss, 2.0 s swing, 2400 to 3192, 180 s, healer 600 HPS) in the engine's own level 60 bear set: this order gave about 1005 threat per second against 806 for Primal Bite and Maul alone (Berserk, then in the rotation, added 4 percent; client 1.60.1.70707 removed it from the tree), Barkskin cost 1.6 percent threat for 5 percent less damage taken. Demoralizing Roar is kept up after Faerie Fire (round 14, owner ruling: the tank boss carries a Classic creature's attack power, 268 at level 63, and a creature's swing scales with it as a share, so the roar's 204 takes about 23 percent off every swing): raid 60, 10,000 iterations, damage taken about 20 percent lower for about 5 percent less threat. Left out on purpose: Enrage, which bought 2.7 percent threat for 1.8 percent more damage taken (measured when the engine took 27 percent of base armor for 10 s; the client's text is 27 percent in Bear Form and 16 percent in Dire Bear Form, which the engine now uses), a trade a tank rotation should not make by default. Client 1.60.1.70707 made Lacerate a Feral talent (the guide build takes it) and Primal Bite the Feral capstone. The Lacerate bleed stacking, its direct hit (10% weapon damage per stack already up, live tooltip), Frenzied Regeneration's conversion and Enrage's armor penalty are not in the client tables and are the engine's stated assumptions (sim/druid/lacerate.go, enrage.go, frenzied_regeneration.go). Primal Bite's level 60 rank is rank 3 (1238070): the client teaches no rank 4 (its learn row was removed by the 70707 push), and both deal the same 77. Guide rewrite (2026-11-02): the bear Enrages 1 s before the pull, as real bears open: 10 rage up front and 2 a second for 10 seconds, with the armor it costs gone 9 s into the fight. Raid 60, 10,000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001: threat 1001.0 to 1009.2 a second (+0.8%), damage taken 581.4 to 584.0 (+0.45%), TMI 48.7 to 48.8.

priorityList.notes: Potions, trinkets and racials as they come up. Mighty Rage Potion goes down in Bear Form without breaking it.
On cooldown: 20% less damage taken for 15 seconds of every minute, and Forever lets you cast it in Bear Form.
Under half health with 20 rage or more to turn into health.
On cooldown: your biggest threat hit, every 6 seconds.
Until it has five stacks, and again when it has under 3 seconds left. Each stack makes the next cast hit harder, and the bleed turns on Rend and Tear.
When the target has no Faerie Fire on it. In Bear Form it is free on a 6 second cooldown and carries threat, so it is also your ranged pull.
Keep it on the boss: 204 attack power off it at 60 takes about a fifth of its melee damage away. Refresh it in its last 3 seconds.
Queued on your next swing whenever you have 15 rage. It costs 10 with Ferocity, so this keeps rage back for Primal Bite and Lacerate.
Above 40 rage, as the rage dump. It hits up to three targets, so on a pack it is your main threat.
